name: Vol-compression breakout (cross out of low-vol coil, BTC/ETH)
rationale: THESIS: the most powerful trends are BORN from volatility compression — a long quiet coil (low realized vol) stores energy, and the regime SHIFT (vol expanding while price breaks up) is the tradable event, not the steady-state level. We require realized vol to be low (vol_realized BOUNDED, lt-ceiling, the coil precondition) AND a fresh positive momentum break (ret_Nd>0) to catch the expansion's first leg, on the two deepest majors where coils are cleanest. DISCONFIRMER: run the IDENTICAL ret_Nd>0 entry with the vol_realized<ceiling coil precondition REMOVED (momentum that fires in any vol state). If the compression-timed version is not better risk-adjusted net of fees, the coil-then-break timing is fitted and this is plain momentum. Also: the rule should beat entering AFTER vol is already high (chasing the expansion late).
catalyst: Realized vol has compressed to a low coil and price breaks upward (positive short-horizon return) — the regime transition from calm to expansion.
